common_kit.role: Reusable surfaces, props, overlays, and masks. Puzzle assets may override it.

matrix_skin.surface_policy: Four interlocking hotel spaces are clipped from the puzzle matrix; clockwork-hotel-v1 only supplies flat hand-drawn surfaces.
matrix_skin.object_policy: All object-kit/v3 overlays come from one shared style master and never change puzzle facts.

background.usage: asset is optional page atmosphere; board_asset is deterministic programmatic board rendering; board logic remains cell driven
